verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a state business-filing registry, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes what a third party may file on an entity's behalf, any authorization or consent forms, or which signatures must be made personally. The closest items only say that typing your name in the signature block is sufficient under s.15.16 F.S. (it does not say who may sign) and that officers and registered agents can be changed. Neither amounts to a published delegation policy.
